narratives.name: AI Advancements and Applications
narratives.summary: This narrative highlights the advancements and applications of AI, including humanoid robots that can perform tasks like tennis and sprinting.

narratives.name: AI in Robotics and Automation
narratives.summary: This narrative explores the role of AI in robotics and automation, including the development of humanoid robots that can perform tasks like service work and industrial settings.

narratives.name: AI in Healthcare and Rehabilitation
narratives.summary: This narrative highlights the applications of AI in healthcare and rehabilitation, including the development of prosthetics and exoskeletons that can respond to human brain signals.
